name: Kingscote Pelican Feeding
reason: Wikivoyage names the free daily 5pm pelican feeding behind the Marine Centre as a Kingscote wildlife stop; permanent daily activity, about half an hour. Objection: a scheduled daily feed rather than a place.

name: Kangaroo Island Marine Centre
reason: Operator/aquarium; the draw is the pelican feeding, covered by Kingscote Pelican Feeding (duplicate).

name: Bay of Shoals Wines
reason: Cellar door; Wikivoyage gives only an address line, not singled out as a destination.

name: Art by Design Kangaroo Island
reason: Commercial gallery/shop; listed among many galleries, not a distinct place.

name: Cygnet River
reason: Town with no draw of its own beyond Duck Lagoon (kept separately) and cellar doors; tourism page for it is Duck Lagoon plus businesses.

name: Duck Lagoon
reason: Tourism board and Wikivoyage name it: koalas, bird hide, walking trail around the lagoon to old eucalyptus distillery ruins and picnic area.

name: Kangaroo Island Spirits
reason: Distillery cellar door/business; one of many cellar doors, not a landmark estate.

name: Kangaroo Island Wool
reason: Farm business/brand, not a visitor place.

name: Springs Road Wine Experiences
reason: Cellar door/operator.

name: Kangaroo Island Brewery
reason: Brewery cellar door; listed with eat and drink venues, no landmark status.

name: Parsons Restaurant
reason: Restaurant.

name: Parndana Soldier Settlement Museum
reason: Tourism board names this small historical display on the soldier settlement scheme on the edge of Parndana; open museum, about 30 min. Objection: small, one-source museum.

name: Australian Red Gum Gallery
reason: Craft shop/gallery selling hand-turned timber products.

name: Clifford's Honey Farm
reason: For: Wikivoyage names it with a hive and film viewing and honey tasting, a long-standing roadside stop on the way to the south coast. Against: listed under Buy, mainly a shop; one counted source.

name: Kangaroo Island Living Honey
reason: Beekeeping tour operator.

name: Ligurian Bee Sanctuary
reason: The 1885 sanctuary is quarantined for the bees; the tourism text only describes it, no public visit offered; honey is bought in shops.

name: Emu Ridge Eucalyptus Distillery
reason: For: Wikivoyage and tourism both name it; shop with distillery and live wallaby/kangaroo. Against: essentially a shop and cafe.

name: Emu Bay
reason: Tourism board names the 4 km white sand safe swimming beach with 100-year-old jetty and boat ramp; also covers the Emu Bay trilobite fossil shale (Emu Bay Shale merged here).

name: Emu Bay Shale
reason: Duplicate of Emu Bay: fossil shale is on the same beach, a tourism-page aside without a distinct visitor site.

name: Stokes Bay
reason: Tourism board: beach reached through a boulder cave tunnel, rock pools; named Australia's best beach 2023.

name: King George Beach
reason: Tourism board names this pebbly cove beach, known for colour at sunset. Objection: brief mention, one source.

name: Snellings Beach
reason: Tourism board names it for swimming, surfing and fishing at the mouth of Middle River. Objection: brief mention.

name: Western River Cove
reason: Tourism board and Wikivoyage name it: beach and campground beneath cliffs at the Western River mouth, glossy black cockatoo habitat.

name: Middle River Dam
reason: No counted source found (tourism and Wikivoyage pages do not mention it); a reservoir.

name: Old Wisanger School
reason: For: tourism board lists the 1884 school as a heritage site visitors can walk through. Against: tiny, one source, access times not stated.

name: Penneshaw Penguin Centre
reason: Wikivoyage and tourism board ("don't miss the little penguins, best on a night tour"): the Penneshaw little penguin colony at Lloyd Collins Reserve, a permanent nightly experience. Objection: access is by guided tour from an operator.

name: Hog Bay
reason: Tourism board names Hog Bay beach at Penneshaw as a swimming and fishing beach. Objection: brief mention.

name: Penneshaw Lookout
reason: For: Wikivoyage lists it (24/7, free, rolling plains by the ocean). Against: a roadside lookout with a short stop, single source.

name: Kangaroo Island Sculpture Trail
reason: Tourism board lists the new outdoor sculpture trail near Penneshaw under natural attractions; open walk. Objection: new, one source.

name: Christmas Cove
reason: Marina; no visitor attraction beyond the harbour.

name: Baudin Conservation Park
reason: Duplicate of Ironstone Hill Hike, the park's one visitor draw (walk to the Bates cottage ruins, whales in season).

name: Ironstone Hill Hike
reason: Parks SA and tourism board: coastal trail to the Bates family cottage ruins, whales in season, glossy black cockatoos; walk visitors do.

name: Cape Willoughby Conservation Park
reason: Parks SA visitor page: state's oldest operating lighthouse, daily visitor centre, tours and coastal walks; Wikivoyage lists the lighthouse. Treat as one place with Cape Willoughby Lighthouse if that is also a candidate.

name: Lashmar Conservation Park
reason: Parks SA and tourism board: Chapman River canoeing, fishing, swimming at Antechamber Bay, picnic area and camping.

name: Antechamber Bay
reason: Duplicate of Lashmar Conservation Park (beach at the park's river mouth).

name: Chapman River
reason: Duplicate of Lashmar Conservation Park (river within it).

name: Dudley Wines
reason: Cellar door; Wikivoyage lists only an address.

name: Sunset Winery
reason: Cellar door; Wikivoyage lists only an address.

name: False Cape Wines
reason: Cellar door, one of many.

name: Cuttlefish Bay
reason: Only mentioned as the address locality of Dudley Wines; no counted source names the bay as a place to go.

name: Rob's Shearing and Sheepdogs
reason: Operator demonstration.
